instructions:
## Published experimental setting

Develop SFT data that improves Qwen3-1.7B-Base across the joint evaluation suite.

The research agent chooses and prepares training records; model identity and optimization settings stay fixed. It can combine retrieved datasets with synthetic examples. Candidate data must pass evaluation-overlap checks.

Each submission trains for 350 steps with global batch 64, sequence length 16,384, and learning rate 1e-5: approximately 367 million tokens. Up to 20 candidate training runs are allowed. Success is measured jointly on AIME2025, GSM8K, HumanEval, and BFCL. The public description provides the research setup, not the complete executable agent prompt.
